note: Live exam + admissions feed for the four live targets (IHBAS, CIP Ranchi, JSS Mysuru, DIMHANS Dharwad). SGT, Amity and RML closed for 2026 and moved to the Archive. Pinned items up top with countdowns; everything else newest-first. Each item carries its source so it's not just me saying it.

pinned.title: IHBAS admit card out: Sun 29 Nov, 10:00 to 11:30 AM, gate shuts 9:45. Your name is not on the eligible list
pinned.body: IHBAS posted the General Instructions and Admit Card for the Master in Clinical Psychology 2026-28 entrance on 26 Nov 2026. Paper Sun 29 Nov, 10:00 to 11:30 AM; report 9:00 AM; nobody gets in after 9:45 AM. Centres by roll number, both on DU North Campus: 260001 to 260800 at Kirori Mal College, 260801 to 261536 at Hansraj College (metro: Vishwavidyalaya, Yellow Line; no parking). The admit card is a blank form in the PDF: fill in the roll number from the eligible list, paste the same photo as on the application, sign, and bring it plus a photocopy, one original photo ID (Aadhaar, Voter ID or Driving Licence) plus a photocopy, and a blue or black ball pen. OMR sheet; no rough work on it. Provisional key on the IHBAS site the same day; challenges Rs 200 a question by email to ihbasmphil.appl@delhi.gov.in by 1 Dec 2026, 2 PM. IHBAS also posted the list of eligible candidates the same day: 1,536 names, roll numbers 260001 to 261536. Every row was read and your name is not on it. DU's letter of 23 Nov had fixed the date; the full day-of details are on the IHBAS plan page.

pinned.title: Christ University M.A. Clinical Psychology (RCI) 2027 is open: apply by 28 Mar 2027, test 4 Apr
pinned.body: CHRIST (Deemed to be University), Bangalore Yeshwanthpur campus, opened applications for its RCI-recognised 2-year M.A. Clinical Psychology on 21 Nov 2026, open until 28 Mar 2027, 11:45 PM. Proposed schedule: entrance test 4 Apr 2027, offline at the Yeshwanthpur campus (120 MCQ, 1 mark each, 90 min; modules: general psychology, biological bases, personality and social, clinical, research methods and stats, cognitive). Results by 7 to 9 Apr; shortlisted candidates come back on 15 Apr for a written essay, a 90-second micro presentation and a 10-minute interview. Merit = test 70% + that round 30%. Eligibility: 4-year BA/BSc Psychology, or a 3-year degree plus the bridge year or 1st year of an MA Psychology, 55%. Fee Rs 5,25,000 a year (Rs 5,05,000 Karnataka domicile) + Rs 8,000 registration. Marks cards must be uploaded within 5 days of applying. Christ calls the dates a proposed schedule.

feed.title: St John's M.Clin.Psy 2026-27 result is out: 5 selected, 6 waitlisted, your name is not on it
feed.body: St John's posted the Master of Clinical Psychology 2026-27 selection list on its announcements page on 26 Nov 2026, about 3:30 PM IST. 5 candidates are provisionally selected (application nos. 82, 83, 94, 99, 118) and 6 are waitlisted in merit order (96, 34, 15, 116, 108, 28). Your name is not on either list: the list is a text table on the page, not a scan, and all 11 names were read one by one. Admission is subject to original documents and RGUHS approval; classes start Mon 14 Dec 2026. Next up is IHBAS on Sun 29 Nov.

feed.title: UPS Education's admissions list checked against official sites: only Calcutta and Christ are open for you
feed.body: Every clinical psychology listing on UPS Education's Latest Psychology Admissions page was checked on 24 Nov 2026. Open and verified on the official pages: University of Calcutta M.Clin.Psy (apply by 2 Dec, test 8 Dec) and Christ Bengaluru M.A. Clinical Psychology (RCI) (apply by 28 Mar 2027, test 4 Apr). Left off: Mody University's M.Clin.Psy (last date 30 Nov) is for women only per the only source, is not on RCI's approved list up to 23 Oct 2026, and has no notice on Mody's own site; Christ's PG Psychology 2027 (last date 25 Nov) is the non-RCI M.Sc courses. All 48 other clinical listings show closed. RCI's 23 Oct 2026 list adds M.Clin.Psy from 2026-27 at MGM University Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (14), NIMHR Sehore (12), IILDR Dausa (10), Variyar School Salem (16) and IIS Jaipur (10): watch them next cycle. Details in the Open now box on the admissions tracker. Later on 24 Nov you said no to Calcutta, so only Christ is left.

feed.title: RML's 13 seats go through GGSIPU's M.Phil CET (code 157), not CET-166. The 2026-27 round is not out yet
feed.body: Checked on GGSIPU's own notices, 23 Nov 2026. CET-166 (Master in Clinical Psychology, the one sat on 4 Jul) was counselled only at Ashtavakra Institute and Tecnia Institute: the 1st and 2nd counselling seat matrices for 2026-27 list just those two (intake 10 each). RML was never on it. RML's own course is the M.Phil (Clinical Psychology) at the Dept of Clinical Psychology, ABVIMS and Dr RML Hospital, with the degree from GGSIPU and 13 seats (RCI list: 12 + 1 EWS, approved to 2025-26; 2026-27 not printed yet, same as IHBAS). It is filled by GGSIPU's separate M.Phil CET, code 157. The 2025-26 round: brochure 26 Sep 2025, offline forms till 27 Oct 2025 (printed form + Rs 2,500 demand draft to 'Registrar, GGSIPU', handed in at the Facilitation Centre, Dwarka), CET 9 Nov 2025 at Dwarka, 100 MCQ in 2 hours, 4 marks each, no negative, 50% to qualify, 3 per seat called for interview, final rank 90% CET + 10% interview, 13 selected on 15 Dec 2025. Eligibility: master's in psychology, 55% (50% reserved), not by distance or part time. Earlier rounds ran at other times (CET 2 Jun 2024; 2022-23 selection 23 Nov 2022), so the 2026-27 notice can drop any time. This board now watches GGSIPU's code-157 notice list twice a day.

feed.title: IHBAS Delhi 2026-28 notification is out: forms closed 21 Nov, entrance 29 Nov
feed.body: IHBAS posted the Master in Clinical Psychology (RCI, University of Delhi) 2026-28 admission notice on 5 Nov 2026. 28 seats: UR 11, SC 4, ST 2, OBC 7, EWS 3, PwD 1. Eligibility: 4-year BA/BSc in Psychology, or a 3-year degree plus the bridge year or an MA/MSc in Psychology, 55% (50% reserved). Fee Rs 3,000 (Rs 1,500 reserved) paid into the IHBAS SBI account. The paper form, mark sheets, category certificate and fee slip had to reach the Head, Dept of Clinical Psychology, Room 122, Academic Block, IHBAS, by speed/registered post or by hand on or before 21 Nov 2026; email and online forms are not accepted. Entrance 29 Nov 2026 (listed as tentative here; confirmed by DU on 23 Nov, see the newer item); counselling and document verification to be notified after it. Stipend Rs 25,000/month. The prospectus (pattern, syllabus) was promised 'within a few days' and is not on the site yet as of 22 Nov IST. The notice also says '21th November 2025' in one line; the dates table says 21.11.2026.

feed.title: DIMHANS Dharwad 2026-27 notice was out 7 Nov: forms closed 17 Nov, exam was 19 Nov
feed.body: DIMHANS posted its Master of Clinical Psychology 2026-27 notice (Ref DIMHANS/AHS/M.Clin./2026-27, dated 7 Nov 2026). Course approved by RCI, affiliated to RGUHS. 5 seats: UR 3, SC 1, Cat-IIB 1. Karnataka domicile only (certificate from the Tahasildar). Eligibility: 2-year Master's in Clinical, Counselling or Applied Psychology, or Psychology, 55% (50% SC/ST), with Psychology in every UG year. App fee Rs 1,000 (Rs 500 SC/ST) online; form from dimhans.karnataka.gov.in, emailed to dimhanscp@gmail.com with the documents. Online application 8 to 17 Nov 2026 (5 PM). Entrance 19 Nov 2026, 11:00 AM to 12:30 PM at DIMHANS Dharwad: offline, 100 MCQ, 90 min, -0.25 per wrong answer, 50% to qualify (45% SC/ST), then seats by counselling on merit. Both dates have passed; the old watcher missed this notice, and DIMHANS is now on the watch list. The DIMHANS site does not load from outside India, so the link is the scan of the official notice posted by Power Within Psychology.

feed.title: SGT University — MA Clinical Psychology (RCI) application closes
feed.body: Open right now, and the only one of your five flagged colleges with a live near-term window. MA Clinical Psychology (RCI) (the old M.Phil, renamed), 10 seats, app fee Rs 1,500. Dates are aggregator-sourced (UPS Education / Power Within) and tagged tentative, so confirm on the portal, but treat 4 Jul as your apply-by.

feed.title: Application + exam dates pulled for your 5 flagged colleges (Amity / SGT / IHBAS / CIP / JSS)
feed.body: You asked, here it is, verified off the portals, no fake dates. SGT — OPEN, form by ~4 Jul, written ~11 Jul 2026. Amity Noida — OPEN (rolling 2026 intake, no single hard deadline; selection is interview-led, exam date not published). JSS Mysuru — not open yet, runs an October cycle (aggregator window ~7 Oct form / ~16 Oct entrance, verify). IHBAS Delhi — 2026-28 M.Phil notification NOT out yet (last cycle was Aug form / 28 Sep exam; expect Aug–Sep). CIP Ranchi — 2026 notification NOT out yet (CBT historically ~Feb). Bottom line: only SGT needs action this week. Full grid on the tracker.

feed.title: Amity Noida (AIBHAS) — Clinical Psychology 2026 intake OPEN
feed.body: Amity's 2026 admissions are open and run rolling/phased, so there's no single hard last date you can lock a countdown to (aggregators throw out Feb/Apr/May/Jun, none official). The RCI MA Clinical Psych selection is interview-led; the official course page lists a Personal Interview, not a separate written test, and no interview date is published. Apply on the portal and call AIBHAS Noida (0120-4713600) to confirm the RCI MA + M.Phil intake. App fee ~Rs 1,100.

feed.title: JSS Mysuru — Clinical Psychology runs an OCTOBER cycle (not open yet)
feed.body: JSS AHER's clinical psych entrance (now MA Clinical Psychology (RCI), the renamed M.Phil) is an October cycle. Official site still shows only 2025 results; the 2026 brochure isn't live. Aggregator (UPS Education) projects form ~7 Oct, entrance test + viva ~16 Oct 2026, which matches JSS's real Oct cadence (2024 closed 8 Oct, exam 22 Oct), so plausible but unconfirmed. Re-check jssuni.edu.in or email clinicalpsychology@jssuni.edu.in around Aug–Sep.

feed.title: CIP Ranchi: 2026 notification still NOT out (re-checked 22 Nov 2026)
feed.body: Re-checked 22 Nov 2026 IST: no 2026 MA Clinical Psychology notice on the CIP application portal (hllcip.cbtexam.in, unchanged since its 2025-session content) or in UPS Education's CIP category; the official site cipranchi.nic.in does not load from outside India. No 2026 intake was published at all. The 2025 cycle (official prospectus) ran online forms 19 Mar to 15 Apr 2025, CBT 27 Apr, practical + viva 13 to 15 May, so the next window is likely around March. App fee Rs 1,000 (Rs 500 OBC/SC/ST/PwD), scholarship Rs 25,000/mo, 210-bed hostel. Selection is CBT (100) + interview/practical (50), ~21 seats. Watch out: the '30 Aug 2026' date floating around is NEET-PG for MD Psychiatry, not this program.

feed.title: Focus narrowed to five — NIMHANS + Manipal off the board
feed.body: Everything now points at five live targets: Amity Noida, SGT, RML, IHBAS and CIP (Ranchi). NIMHANS and Manipal/MET are done for this cycle (both sat, both closed), so they've been pulled off the tracker, the dashboard and this feed so they're not in your face. feed.title: RML / ABVIMS — MA Clinical Psychology (RCI) application closes
feed.body: Closes first of everything live. Runs on the GGSIPU portal, admission is the CET-166 entrance (not your MET). 70% test + 30% interview, app fee Rs 2,500. Deadline was extended from 30 May to 7 June, so it is genuinely open. Do this one today.

feed.title: RCI Admissions Tracker rebuilt — DIMHANS Dharwad added
feed.body: Full RCI Clinical Psych tracker re-checked against the institute portals. Added DIMHANS Dharwad (RCI, own psychiatric hospital for in-house clinical hours). Two gates on it: Karnataka domicile is mandatory and the M.Phil track is only a handful of seats. Cycle historically opens ~Sep–Oct.

feed.title: RML / ABVIMS deadline extended to 7 June
feed.body: ABVIMS / Dr RML Hospital pushed its MA Clinical Psychology (RCI) application deadline from 30 May to 7 June 2026 on the GGSIPU portal. That makes it your earliest live window, so it goes first.

feed.title: Christ University is CLOSED (the 'June 14' was wrong)
feed.body: Earlier note said Christ Delhi NCR was open until 14 June. That is wrong: Christ's RCI MA Clinical Psych closed 2 February 2026 with the entrance in February. Don't chase it for this cycle. If you see a 'Delhi NCR June' date anywhere it's a different non-RCI stream, check the RCI tag first.

feed.title: M.Phil Clinical Psychology replaced by the RCI MA
feed.body: From 2026, under NEP 2020 + RCI restructuring, the old M.Phil Clinical Psychology is being replaced by the MA Clinical Psychology (RCI). So the RCI-tagged MA at IHBAS / CIP / RML / Amity (where tagged) IS the licensing program now, not a lesser step. A plain MA/MSc with no RCI tag does not license you. The only thing that matters is the RCI tag.

feed.title: 2027 cycle — the heavy hitters reopen Dec 2026–Feb 2027
feed.body: IHBAS, CIP Ranchi and RINPAS typically open applications between December 2026 and February 2027, entrances around April–May. If this cycle doesn't land, that's your real runway for the top RCI seats. This board will flag each one the day it opens.

feed.title: University of Calcutta M.Clin.Psy 2026-28: you said no (24 Nov)
feed.body: You said no on 24 Nov, so it is off the pinned list and nothing gets built for it. For reference: University of Calcutta (Clinical Psychology Centre) invited online applications for its RCI-approved 2-year Masters in Clinical Psychology (M.Clin.Psy), session 2026-2028, notice dated 6 Nov 2026. Online form and fee 10 Nov to 2 Dec 2026 up to 2:00 PM. Hall ticket 5 Dec. Written test 8 Dec 2026, 11 AM to 12 noon (report 10 AM), offline at Rajabazar Science College campus, 92 A.P.C. Road, Kolkata: 75 MCQ in 1 hour, 0.25 negative per wrong answer. Viva (25 marks) 10 and 11 Dec. 24 seats (UR 13, SC 5, ST 1, OBC 2, EWS 2, PwD 1); reservation applies to West Bengal domicile only, so other states compete in the open seats. Eligibility: 4-year BA/BSc Psychology, or 3-year degree plus the bridge year or the 1st or both years of an MA/MSc in Psychology, 55% (50% SC/ST/PwD). Test fee Rs 1,000 (Rs 500 SC/ST/PwD). Course fee: Rs 5,000 admission a year, Rs 5,000 a month tuition, Rs 1,000 exam fee a year.
